label: TP-Link EAP225-Outdoor
description: AC1200 outdoor access point: one gigabit port with 802.3af or 24 V passive PoE, dual-band Wi-Fi 5, weatherproof.
notes: Vendor figures from the TP-Link datasheet: 1x gigabit Ethernet RJ-45 port; 802.11ac 5 GHz 6.5-867 Mbps and 2.4 GHz 78-300 Mbps (802.11a/b/g/n/ac); powered by 802.3af PoE or 24 V passive PoE via the included injector. Gigabit uplink here, unlike the EAP225-Wall.
